text: The art exhibition's theme revolves around urban life and its relentless pace. To complement the visual art pieces, a playlist with hip-hop tracks will play in the background, incorporating the genre's characteristic beats and lyrical flow to echo the energetic and often gritty atmosphere of city living. The rhythmic pulse of the basslines mirrors the heartbeat of the metropolis, while the sharp, staccato delivery of the verses captures the fragmented, fast-moving nature of street life. This auditory layer transforms the gallery space into a dynamic environment where the visual grit of the artwork is amplified by the raw, unfiltered energy of the music, creating an immersive experience that feels as immediate and intense as navigating a crowded city block.
